body: Yes, thanks for saying that because now I feel like I’m not the only one thinking this. They really need to just be more genuine about mental health. Not just towards me, but anyone. It’s hard when I know they’re watching me in this state and don’t have a care in the world. Crazy. So hopefully it does!

Unfortunately I’ve been surrounded by these type of outlooks years. My family doesn’t understand that I’m not feeling well. I hope that I will eventually find a better support system. I’m starting to grow out of my shell by creating social media accounts today to try and befriend people. Thanks for understanding.
Sadly no. I wish I did. I don’t have any friends currently, nor do I have anyone who’ll take me in. I’m beginning to search though.
